info.name: FIKRA Agency API
info.description:
Laravel 12 API for the FIKRA Agency website and dashboard.

1. Run **Admin auth → Login**; the token is stored automatically in the `token` collection variable.
2. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`).
3. Populate the `*Id` / `*Slug` variables from list responses.

Docs: `/docs` · OpenAPI: `/docs.json`

item.name: Public catalogue
item.description: Cached public read endpoints (10 minute TTL, invalidated by admin writes).

item.name: Public forms
item.description: Rate limited to 5 requests/minute per IP and honeypot protected. Attachments go to the private disk.

request.description: Send `description` for a quote request; two queued emails are sent.

formdata.value: We need a bilingual storefront with Stripe checkout.

request.description: Send `message` (without `description`) for a plain contact message.

item.name: Admin auth
item.description: Sanctum bearer tokens. Login stores the token in the collection variable.

request.description: On success the test script saves `data.token` into the collection variable `token`.

item.name: Admin · content
item.description: CRUD for catalogue content. Editors have access; `PUT` requires the full localized payload.

item.name: Admin · media & inbox
item.description: Media library (projects/posts/team/testimonials/users) plus quote, message and newsletter management.

item.name: Admin · settings, users & dashboard
item.description: Administrator-only settings and user management; dashboard is available to any staff member.
